auto_setup.title: Automatic Seamless Co-op and ModEngine Setup
auto_setup.instructions:
This setup wizard will help you configure Seamless Co-op with ModEngine.

1. Select your Elden Ring game folder
2. Set your co-op password
3. The setup wizard will automatically:
   - Download and install ModEngine
   - Download and install Seamless Co-op
   - Configure all required files
   - Save your settings
auto_setup.github_nexus_warning: Important: The GitHub release mirror may be older than the current Nexus Mods release. If Seamless Co-op does not start, install the latest version from Nexus Mods manually.
auto_setup.me2_legacy_warning: ModEngine 2 is obsolete and no longer maintained. Install it only when a mod explicitly requires ME2 and you understand the compatibility limits.
auto_setup.invalid_game_path: eldenring.exe was not found in the selected folder.
auto_setup.success_message: The selected ModEngine loader and Seamless Co-op {version} were installed successfully.
